name: You Are Item #65,536 in the Dragon Girl's Hoard
source:
What happens when a dragon steals you along with an entire game store filled with priceless treasures? Depends on how she's feeling that day. Experience everyday life of being part of a dragon's hoard!

[From [url=https://broccolily.itch.io/dragon-hoard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一条龙偷走了你以及一整家充满无价宝藏的游戏商店时，会发生什么？取决于她那天的心情。体验成为龙宝库一部分的日常生活！

[来自[url=https://broccolily.itch.io/dragon-hoard]itch.io[/url]]
